adjudication.rationale: In app/models/post.rb, Post#cook now returns `raw` early when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, which bypasses `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)` entirely. The diff also introduces imported posts that explicitly set `cook_method: :raw_html` (TopicEmbed.import uses PostCreator with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`). Therefore any plugin relying on the `:after_post_cook` hook will not run for these imported posts, creating silent behavior divergence; and because these posts contain externally sourced HTML, skipping post-cook filters/sanitizers is a potentially serious security/correctness issue grounded in the code shown.
